name.description:
Name of the trace formed from concatenation of typename and methodname of root action.
For example, `Observability.Trace#list` and `WindTurbine#echo` could be possible values.

startTime.description:
The start time of this {@link Observability.Trace}
This is the earliest {@link Observability.Span#startTime} of all spans belonging to this trace.

endTime.description:
The end time of this {@link Observability.Trace}
This is the latest {@link Observability.Span#endTime} of all spans belonging to this trace.

durationInMillis.description:
Duration of this {@link Observability.Trace}.
This is the difference between {@link Observability.Trace#startTime} and
the {@link Observability.Trace#endTime}.

spanCount.description: Number of {@link Observability.Span}s in this {@link Observability.Trace}.

errorCount.description: Number of {@link Observability.Span}s in this {@link Observability.Trace} that have errors.

status.description: The status code of this {@link Observability.Trace}.

hasAggregationErrors.description: True if there were errors during aggregation

llmCallsTokenSum.description: Number of total tokens, uses "SUM" aggregation

llmCallsMaxTokens.description: Number of total tokens, uses "MAX" aggregation

llmCallsLatencySum.description: Latency of all LLM calls in seconds, uses "SUM" aggregation

llmCallsMaxLatency.description: Latency of LLM calls in seconds, uses "MAX" aggregation
